storyboard.claim: The ground remembers more than any person does.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Bold text card on dark forest-green
storyboard.addedInformation: the thesis that land outlasts people

image.subject: a wide photograph of a muddy forest clearing at dawn in New England, old stone wall half-sunk in moss and fallen leaves, mist between tall pines, no people

storyboard.claim: People pass through but the ground keeps receipts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Empty misty clearing, moss-covered stone wall
storyboard.relationToPrevious: from text card to the place itself

image.subject: a photograph of a massive old oak tree towering over a rotting split-rail fence in a Massachusetts meadow, late afternoon light

storyboard.claim: Humans fight to own the land while the forest outlives them all.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Huge oak dwarfing a rotting fence
storyboard.relationToPrevious: from the clearing to the contest over ownership
storyboard.addedInformation: ownership fences decay while the tree stays

image.subject: a photograph of tree roots wrapping around old weathered bones half-buried in dark forest soil, moss and fallen leaves, soft green light

storyboard.claim: The forest literally feeds on human bones.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Roots coiled around bones in soil
storyboard.relationToPrevious: tightens from fences to what lies under them

storyboard.claim: The place, not the people, is the true protagonist.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Large text card stating the thesis

image.subject: a close photograph of a single apple seed resting on old yellowed ribs of a skeleton in dark earth, shallow depth of field

storyboard.claim: A single apple seed buried in a dead man's ribs maps a century of human greed.
storyboard.concreteVisual: One seed on bare ribs
storyboard.relationToPrevious: begins the first of three promises
storyboard.addedInformation: the apple seed as the story's engine

image.subject: a photograph of a dying apple tree leaf covered in blight spots, rusty fungal rot, in an orchard with old muskets rusting in the grass behind

storyboard.claim: Microscopic invaders hold more power than any human army.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Blighted leaf in front of rusting muskets

image.subject: a photograph of an old yellow clapboard colonial farmhouse at dusk in a New England clearing, tall trees crowding close around it, one lit window

storyboard.claim: The ghosts haunting the yellow house are the trees.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Yellow farmhouse ringed by trees
storyboard.addedInformation: the yellow house and its tree-ghosts

storyboard.claim: How does brutal violence birth a legendary wonder?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Question card
storyboard.relationToPrevious: poses the question driving the opening

image.subject: a photograph of a dark wet meadow at night in New England, cold fog, bare branches, a single faint lantern glow far away, mud and puddles in the grass

storyboard.claim: To understand the land, stand in a pitch black wet freezing meadow.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Black night meadow with fog
storyboard.relationToPrevious: answers the question with a place

image.subject: a photograph of a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, digging a grave with a heavy iron shovel in a wet dark meadow at night, lantern on the ground beside her

storyboard.claim: An unnamed captive mother digs a grave alone in the dark.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Young mother digging with iron shovel
storyboard.addedInformation: the captive mother and the grave

image.subject: a photograph of a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, dragging a long dark cloth-wrapped bundle through deep mud across a wet meadow at night, leaning back with effort, a wide-brimmed hat lying in the mud nearby

storyboard.claim: She drags the poisoned English scout's body through the mud.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Woman hauling a wrapped body, hat in mud

image.subject: a close photograph of a half-eaten apple core lying in dark wet earth next to a worn leather jerkin, cold blue light

storyboard.claim: Inside the dead man's stomach is an unweed apple core.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Apple core on dirt beside leather clothing
storyboard.addedInformation: the apple core as the key clue

storyboard.claim: You are in the present tense right beside her.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text card
storyboard.onScreenText: You are right there with her

image.subject: a close photograph of an iron shovel blade pulling out of thick wet black mud, mud clinging to the metal, cold dark light

storyboard.claim: You hear the heavy sucking mud clinging to the shovel.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Close view of muddy shovel blade

image.subject: a photograph of a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, kneeling in the dark meadow, face wet with tears and exhausted, breath visible in the cold air, lantern light on her face

storyboard.claim: You hear her ragged, weeping breath as a young mother who has lost nearly everything.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Exhausted weeping woman, visible breath
storyboard.relationToPrevious: moves from the sound of mud to the sound of her

image.subject: a close photograph of an iron shovel blade striking grey bedrock at the bottom of a hole dug in dark earth

storyboard.claim: The shovel blade rings against bedrock deep in the earth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Shovel blade hitting grey stone in a pit
storyboard.relationToPrevious: a sudden sharp sound after the breathing

image.subject: a photograph of a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, standing hunched in cold rain at the edge of dark colonial forest, bare trees around her

storyboard.claim: In the colonial wilderness with a baby strapped to her back, the elements fight her.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Mother hunched in rain with baby on back
storyboard.addedInformation: baby on her back, weather against her

storyboard.claim: That image changes how we look at the landscape today.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text card
storyboard.relationToPrevious: turns from scene to modern view

image.subject: a photograph of a pristine sunlit New England forest in autumn, golden maples, a still pond, no people, postcard beauty

storyboard.claim: Every pristine, supposedly untouched piece of nature that we romanticize.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Postcard-pretty autumn forest and pond

image.subject: a photograph of a gorgeous apple tree in full white blossom in an orchard in spring sunlight, petals drifting, soft golden light

storyboard.claim: A flowering apple tree sends our minds to the Garden of Eden.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Apple tree in full blossom
storyboard.relationToPrevious: a specific beautiful case of the romance

storyboard.claim: We think of peace and bounty, but the book demands otherwise.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text card

image.subject: a close photograph of dark rich forest soil held in a cupped hand, roots, dead leaves and a fragment of old bone showing

storyboard.claim: You must look at the soil, at what decomposes to feed those roots.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Handful of soil with bone fragment and roots
storyboard.relationToPrevious: the reversal: look down, not up

image.subject: a photograph of a burnt-out colonial wooden village palisade at dawn in New England, smoke rising from charred cabins, a broken wooden gate, no people

storyboard.claim: This is the era of brutal colonial skirmishes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Smoking ruined palisade village
storyboard.relationToPrevious: backs up to how she got here

image.subject: a photograph of a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, being led away by a rope between trees, looking back over her shoulder at distant smoke rising from a burned village

storyboard.claim: She was taken captive in a horrific raid on her village, her family slaughtered.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Woman led by a rope, looking back at smoke

image.subject: a photograph of a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, stumbling through deep snow in a bare winter forest, gaunt, shivering, shawl clutched at her chest, long line of dark trees ahead

storyboard.claim: She is marched deep into the wilderness, suffering exposure and hunger.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Gaunt woman wading through snowy forest

image.subject: a photograph of an older woman in her sixties, weathered face, grey hair under a plain cap, a worn wool cloak and apron, standing in the doorway of a small rough log cabin deep in the woods, smoke from a chimney, tall trees behind her

storyboard.claim: She is left with an older woman, a former English captive who chose to stay in the deep woods.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Older woman at a forest cabin door

image.subject: a photograph of a small remote log cabin deep in a dense New England forest, far from any road, a thin line of chimney smoke, a faint distant meetinghouse spire far below the hills

storyboard.claim: She chose the woods, away from Puritan society.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Remote cabin, far-off meetinghouse spire
storyboard.relationToPrevious: explains why the woman lives apart

image.subject: a photograph of a rugged English militiaman in his thirties, beard, leather jerkin and wide-brimmed hat, musket at his side, with two other militiamen in similar dress, walking in single file along a forest trail toward a log cabin, muskets on their shoulders

storyboard.claim: English scouts arrive, ostensibly as rescuers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Three armed militiamen approaching the cabin

storyboard.claim: The scouts bring a grotesque trophy, the severed hand of a native child.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Older woman recoiling from a sack on the table

image.subject: a photograph of an older woman in her sixties, weathered face, grey hair under a plain cap, a worn wool cloak and apron, standing in her cabin with a hard, resolute stare as she turns toward an iron pot over the fire, firelight on her weathered face

storyboard.claim: The older woman sees the endless cycle of bloodshed the scouts represent.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Older woman resolute before the fire pot

image.subject: a photograph of an iron cooking pot of steaming broth hanging over a hearth fire in a rustic log cabin, sprigs of dark berried nightshade lying on the wooden table beside it

storyboard.claim: She serves them a broth made from poisonous nightshade.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Steaming pot with nightshade on the table

storyboard.claim: Horrific, necessary violence meant to stop further violence.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Pull-quote card

image.subject: a photograph of a young woman in her twenties, thin, hair tied back, ragged colonial dress and shawl, mud on her hands, a baby strapped to her back, gripping a wood-chopping axe, standing protectively in a dim cabin doorway at dusk, fierce expression, the axe held low and still

storyboard.claim: The mother ferociously defends her child and finishes off the last surviving scout.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Fierce mother holding axe at the doorway

image.subject: a photograph of a rugged English militiaman in his thirties, beard, leather jerkin and wide-brimmed hat, musket at his side, sitting by a campfire at dusk smiling and holding out half a red apple with an offering hand

storyboard.claim: Hours earlier, the same man had offered her a bite of an apple.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Scout smiling, offering a red apple

image.subject: a photograph of a row of fresh low dirt mounds in a wet New England meadow at dusk, an iron shovel stuck upright in the nearest mound, cold fog

storyboard.claim: She buries him with the other dead scouts in the wet meadow.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Fresh grave mounds with shovel upright

image.subject: a wide photograph of an empty meadow at dawn, fresh graves fading under mist while a tiny figure of a woman with a baby disappears into far dark trees at the edge

storyboard.claim: The narrative doesn't follow the escaping mother but stays with the ground, and a year passes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Meadow in mist, tiny figure leaving at edge
storyboard.relationToPrevious: switches the camera from mother to land

image.subject: a photograph of two gaunt grey wolves sniffing at a patch of disturbed earth in a spring meadow, thin ribs showing, slush and patchy snow around them

storyboard.claim: Starving wolves sniff out the shallow grave after the snow melts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two thin wolves sniffing a grave mound

image.subject: a photograph of a grey wolf dragging a dark cloth-wrapped bundle up a muddy hillside in a spring forest, the meadow below

storyboard.claim: They drag the corpse up the hill to tear it apart.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Wolf hauling a wrapped body uphill

image.subject: a macro photograph of a single apple seed cracking open with a pale root tip emerging, lying among old bones in warm spring sunlight, soft green background

storyboard.claim: In the spring sunlight the apple seed from his stomach cracks its coat.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Macro seed splitting among bones
